information.name: echo-sso
information.description: Single sign-on bridge from the UISP client zone to the Echo messaging application. Clients click through from the portal and land directly in Echo without a separate login.
information.author: LocalSplash

configuration.label: Identity (id) Base URL
configuration.description: Base URL of the id identity processor, no trailing slash, e.g. https://id.wisp.net. Signs the client in domain-wide and forwards them into Echo.

configuration.label: SSO Shared Secret
configuration.description: HMAC-SHA256 hex secret shared with the id identity processor (UISP_SSO_SECRET in the oAuthConfig settings table). Keep this private.
